description: AWS WAF challenge-algorithm → PoW solver mapping. Keys are SHA-256 hashes (hex, lowercase) of the challenge descriptor emitted by the browser challenge script. Updated when xKiian/awswaf-solver publishes a new map.

e07e04f2bd2dac5b1ad2a4c9bda2d7d6c4b7a7c3.notes: Plain SHA-256 over the challenge blob. No KDF.

12a34b56c78d90ef12a34b56c78d90ef12a34b56.notes: Iterated SHA-256 until leading N bits are zero.

deadbeefcafebabe1234567890abcdef12345678.notes: Zero-filled 512KiB buffer, base64-encoded. Trivial bandwidth verifier.
